method: Unblinded qualitative inspection by one agent of every saved output; not a human preference study, validated coherence metric, or proof of general capability. Text inspection completed before evaluation metrics were read; metrics were not needed for this release decision.
narrative_improvement: No consistent qualitative narrative improvement established for context128 over context64 or live004. Brief readable openings in a few context64 outputs do not persist. Context128 also produces severe grammar failures and topic drift.
recall_improvement: No sampled exact name-recall improvement:0/8 for each model. All4 paired name swaps produce identical sampled continuations within each model. This does not imply identical logits or no latent cue sensitivity; report forced-choice scores separately.
repetition_observation: Repeated stock fragments recur across different ordinary prompts/seeds, e.g. context64 seed1729 repeatedly ends with The cat of the door. The bus saw a sm. This is cross-sample convergence; no quantitative repetition metric or indefinite looping claim.
recommendation: Retain live model004. Preserve both candidates as experimental checkpoints; do not deploy either on this evidence.
